body: Audit B-59 and the restore round trip (6 Nov 2026, run): identity, accounts, passwords, device tokens, playlists and a pre-backup signed address survive a restore; what was made after the backup is gone from the server but stays on phones (P2-27). The restored file must belong to the server's user (uid 1000), as `encore restore` does with chown. docs/evidence/README.md#d01.
